# Arizona Capitol Times

> Arizona Capitol Times is the leading source for Arizona political news, state government coverage, and legislative intelligence.

Arizona Capitol Times provides comprehensive coverage of Arizona state politics, legislation, and government affairs. The publication serves as a critical news source for tracking policy developments, legislative activity, and political leadership across Arizona.

## Key Topics

- Arizona politics
- State legislature
- Arizona government
- Governor Hobbs
- Arizona House
- Colorado River water policy
- Legislative districts
- Awards and recognition
- Arizona leadership
- Public notices
- Government affairs
- Policy analysis
- Political news
- Maricopa County
- Arizona GOP

## Core News & Information

- [Homepage](https://azcapitoltimes.com): Homepage featuring Arizona political news, legislation updates, and key state government stories.
- [Email Alerts](https://azcapitoltimes.com/email-alerts): Email alert subscription for breaking Arizona political and government news.
- [Subscription Plans](https://azcapitoltimes.com/subscription-page): Subscription plans and pricing for Arizona Capitol Times news access.
- [About Us](https://azcapitoltimes.com/about-us): Company overview of Arizona Capitol Times and State Affairs operations.

## Events & Forums

- [Events Calendar](https://azcapitoltimes.com/events): Calendar of Arizona Capitol Times events including Morning Scoop and awards ceremonies.
- [Morning Scoop](https://azcapitoltimes.com/morning-scoop): Breakfast forum events featuring policy experts and government officials.
- [Morning Scoop: Colorado River Water Policy](https://azcapitoltimes.com/event/morning-scoop-a-coalition-for-protecting-arizonas-lifeline): Event coverage on Colorado River water policy and Arizona's water security challenges.
- [Best of the Capitol 2026](https://azcapitoltimes.com/event/best-of-the-capitol-2): Annual awards event honoring Arizona political figures and organizations.
- [Leaders of the Year in Public Policy 2024](https://azcapitoltimes.com/event/leaders-of-the-year-in-public-policy): Annual awards recognizing Arizona leaders advancing state policy and quality of life.
- [Women Achievers of Arizona 2025](https://azcapitoltimes.com/women-achievers-of-arizona): Awards event recognizing professional women advancing Arizona communities.

## Public Notices & Legal Services

- [Public Notices](https://azcapitoltimes.com/public-notice): Legal and government notice publication service for Arizona.
- [Public Notice Details & FAQ](https://azcapitoltimes.com/public-notice/about): Guide for publishing legal and business notices in Arizona Capitol Times.
- [Public Notice FAQ](https://azcapitoltimes.com/public-notice/faq): FAQ on public notice categories including bids, real estate, and probate.
